findings.title: Revalidate governing-fee dependencies at catalog lifecycle and current projection boundaries
findings.observation: The suite stores a governing_fee_digest, but current catalog capability and case resolution only recheck adapter/source-literal authority. They do not resolve the stored fee dependency against a current registry. The API injects governing-fee contexts into tests, preview and dispatch, but not catalog reads or approve/activate actions.
findings.exact_reproduction: Use public load_package/build_fee_registry and snapshot helpers. Install Northwind; submit January expected ELIGIBLE/USD2400 and March unknown with the issued January context; then close that registry. Fresh shadow_preview with the same issued context correctly returns amount=null. get_vendor still returns actual.amount=2400.00, passed=true and an approve action; approve and activate both succeed. Separately, dispatch while the context is valid and then close it: Workbench.case, catalog.resolve_case(require_active=True), and portfolio estimated rollup still return USD2400.
affected_consumers: Current catalog checks and approval/activation actions
Current availability case including governing_fee_cents and trace
findings.expected_boundary: Unavailable governing-fee authority must invalidate current capability and current monetary projections. Keep original test results, case versions and receipts as explicit recorded history; current positive values cannot survive registry revocation.
findings.historical_evidence: The case probe confirms archived case_versions are unchanged. The desired repair is current authority/projection containment, not rewriting old evidence.
findings.qualification: No positive dispatch with the closed context was demonstrated: fresh evaluation correctly refuses. The defect is stale lifecycle authority and current saved money. The pending correspondence composition and advance-billing join are not part of this finding.
findings.recommended_correction: Provide a trusted current fee-registry resolution path to catalog reads/actions and saved-case projections. Compare all positive-contributor dependency digests at the relevant boundary, suppress current checks/amounts and actions when unavailable, and preserve known zero without a fee dependency. Persist digests rather than trusted serialized contexts.

findings.title: Reject duplicate exact authenticated-envelope lookup keys before building FeeRegistry
findings.observation: Duplicate detection uses tenant/account/vendor/contract/service/plan/month/fee_line_id, whereas the actual dictionary key is tenant plus Scope. Plan and fee_line_id are absent from Scope. Consequently two entries with identical lookup Scope but different plan or fee_line_id bypass the duplicate check and the later entry silently replaces the earlier one.
findings.exact_reproduction: first = entry(load_package()); other = dataclasses.replace(first, entry_id='same-envelope-other-plan', plan='Enterprise'). FeeRegistry((first,other)) resolves the unchanged public signed snapshot to Enterprise; FeeRegistry((other,first)) resolves it to Business. Both constructors succeed and both contexts carry fee_minor=1200000.
findings.expected_boundary: An authenticated envelope must select exactly one configured input independently of iteration order. Reject any repeated _scope_key at construction, in addition to the existing financial-overlap check.
findings.qualification: This requires ambiguous operator configuration, not browser-supplied entries. The normal manifest/context plan comparison may subsequently refuse the wrong-plan context; it does not make order-dependent registry selection valid.

independent_falsifiers.result: 3 failed in 0.44s; original failing assertions preserved

verified_controls: January produces USD2400 through the current issued fee context with no advance-billing implementation.
Completed-step floor, cap and final HALF_UP cent rounding agree with the independent rational reference, including large exact integers.
FixedMonthlyTerms recompile the complete source and reject mismatched source spans/version/rate or extra qualification; invoice quantity cannot multiply the fixed monthly fee.
The flat monthly_fee_cents assertion does not set or raise the new step-family fee base.
Known zero rate remains ineligible with null nonclaimable amount and no fee digest; incomplete usage remains unknown without a rate.
Original, copied, replaced, deep-copied and pickle-round-tripped contexts have the intended identity behavior; closed registry and changed dependency are refused by direct require_governing_fee.
Signed snapshot/body scope mismatches, missing grant provenance and future-known inputs refuse in the public controls.
intentional_limits_not_findings: March advance billing and complete-March governing fee are deferred Change B functionality; no additional defect is inferred from their unsupported results.

The bounded join is USD only, exactly one contractually fixed subscription unit, one complete-month covered invoice line, and zero separate tax. Absent/split/duplicate/credit-memo invoices and nonzero tax remain unsupported.
Correspondence composition is still in progress and is not claimed complete or reported as a missing join bug.
Exact authored grammar establishes a bounded typed operator under the recorded root decision; it is not a general prose interpreter or proof of real commercial execution.
limits: No private holdout/gold access, credentials, network or native Ramp calls.
No root source edits or full-suite duplication.
No production readiness, actual-human approval, live vendor entitlement or native delivery claim.
